factors.name: VolumeReversalSignal
factors.explanation: Gates a binary signal based on whether volume is above its 5-day z-score, assigning -1 or 1 to indicate potential reversal, capturing the conditional market state of high volume.

factors.name: low_volatility_rank
factors.explanation: Compute the time-series standard deviation of returns over 20 days, then rank it cross-sectionally to identify low-volatility stocks.

factors.name: volatility_transition_zscore
factors.explanation: Measure the change in volatility between 10-day and 20-day windows, standardize it cross-sectionally to capture regime transitions.

factors.name: volatility_reversion_weighted
factors.explanation: Weight the volatility transition by the z-score of returns, using a conditional gate to reinforce mean-reversion in low-volatility stocks.

factors.name: volatility_reversion_rank_diff
factors.explanation: Compare the cross-sectional ranks of 10-day and 20-day volatility to detect shifts in volatility regimes.

runs.hypothesis: When low-volatility stocks show a regime transition in their price dispersion, they exhibit mean-reversion in next-period returns. The mechanism is conditional on the market state of regime transition in low-volatility stocks price dispersion, with the driver being the expected reversal in cross-sectional returns following a regime shift.

factors.name: vol_dispersion_rank
factors.explanation: This computes the cross-sectional rank of a stock's 20-day volatility (price dispersion) to identify low-volatility stocks and detect regime transitions.

factors.name: vol_reversion_zscore
factors.explanation: This standardizes the return deviation from a 20-day moving average to measure mean-reversion in low-volatility stocks.

factors.name: vol_transition_gate
factors.explanation: This applies a conditional gate to detect regime transitions in low-volatility stocks by comparing 10-day and 20-day price dispersion, then standardizes return deviation.

factors.name: vol_reversion_rank
factors.explanation: This ranks the return deviation from a 20-day moving average to identify mean-reversion in low-volatility stocks.

factors.name: vol_dispersion_diff
factors.explanation: This measures the difference between 10-day and 20-day price dispersion to identify regime transitions in low-volatility stocks.

factors.name: vol_reversion_weighted
factors.explanation: This weights the return deviation from a 20-day moving average by the regime transition signal (10-day vs 20-day price dispersion).
